import json,sys,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from h import run
def T(events,**kw): return run({"traces":[trace(events,**kw)]})['traces'][0]
K=[{'keys':['A']}]
# rollback: stream data then a failing frame (unknown type 0x20)
body=stream(0,0,b'abc')+bytes([0x20])
r=T(K+[datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])])
print('rollback:',json.dumps(r['packets']),json.dumps(r['closed']),'used',r['used'],'opened',r['opened'])
# peer close with prefix frames and trailing junk
body=stream(0,0,b'ab')+bytes([0x1d])+v(0)+v(3)+b'bye'+bytes([0x01,0x02])
r=T(K+[datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])])
print('peer close:',json.dumps(r['packets']))
print(' closed',json.dumps(r['closed']),'streams',json.dumps(r['streams']))
canon=bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00])+stream(0,0,b'ab')+bytes([0x1d])+v(0)+v(3)+b'bye'
print(' expect hash',hashlib.sha256(canon).hexdigest(),len(canon),'got',r['datagrams'][0]['bytes'])
# close in the middle of a packet, then more frames ignored, dup PN later
r=T(K+[datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0]),datagram(envelope('A',1,b'\x01'),auth=[0])])
print(' after close:',[p['status'] for p in r['packets']])
# crypto overlap equal and differing
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,crypto(0,b'abc')+crypto(1,b'bc')),auth=[0])])
print('crypto equal overlap:',json.dumps(r['packets']),json.dumps(r['crypto'][0]))
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,crypto(0,b'abc')+crypto(1,b'xc')),auth=[0])])
print('crypto diff overlap:',json.dumps(r['packets']),json.dumps(r['crypto'][0]))
# stream differing overlap
r=T(K+[datagram(envelope('A',0,stream(0,0,b'abc')+stream(0,1,b'xc')),auth=[0])])
print('stream diff overlap:',json.dumps(r['packets']),json.dumps(r['streams']))
# I level with A-only frame
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,bytes([0x10])+v(5)),auth=[0])])
print('MAX_DATA at I:',json.dumps(r['packets']))
# NEW_TOKEN / HANDSHAKE_DONE
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,bytes([0x07])+v(1)+b'\x00'*16),auth=[0])])
print('NEW_TOKEN:',json.dumps(r['packets']),json.dumps(r['closed']))
r=T(K+[datagram(envelope('A',0,bytes([0x1e])),auth=[0])])
print('HANDSHAKE_DONE:',json.dumps(r['packets']))
# empty payload
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,b''),auth=[0])])
print('empty payload:',json.dumps(r['packets']))
# nonminimal type
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,bytes([0x40,0x00])),auth=[0])])
print('nonminimal type:',json.dumps(r['packets']))
# truncated varint in body
r=T([datagram(envelope('I',0,bytes([0x06,0x40])),auth=[0])])
print('truncated varint:',json.dumps(r['packets']))
